## Original article text

````markdown
> Workshop Extensions are a system which allows users to enable certain enhancements, such as access to new effects and increasing the number of dummy bots. These enhancements can be enabled using Extension Points, which are earned by either disabling player slots, disabling all non-Workshop maps, or a combination of both.

The Extensions menu can be accesed by entering the Workshop Editor and clicking the Extensions button <img src="https://imgur.com/XlO3s5O.png" width="24" height="24" alt="Extensions button" />.

4 Extension Points are earned for each disabled player slot, and 16 are earned for leaving only Workshop maps enabled.

The available Extensions are listed below.

<table>
	<thead>
		<tr>
			<th>Extension</th>
			<th>Description</th>
			<th>Cost</th>
		</tr>
	</thead>
	<tbody>
		<tr>
			<td><a href="https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/workshop+extensions+-+beam+effects+reference+sheet">Beam Effects</a></td>
			<td>Adds effects to the Type menu of the Create Beam Effect action. The Color parameter picks a Team Color if given a non-Team Color.</td>
			<td>2</td>
		</tr>
		<tr>
			<td><a href="https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/workshop+extensions+-+beam+sounds+reference+sheet">Beam Sounds</a></td>
			<td>Adds sounds to the Type menu of the Create Effect action.</td>
			<td>1</td>
		</tr>
		<tr>
			<td><a href="https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/workshop+extensions+-+buff+and+debuff+sounds+reference+sheet">Buff and Debuff Sounds</a></td>
			<td>Adds sounds to the Type menu of the Create Effect and Play Effect actions.</td>
			<td>2</td>
		</tr>
		<tr>
			<td><a href="https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/workshop+extensions+-+buff+status+effects+reference+sheet">Buff Status Effects</a></td>
			<td>Adds effects to the Type menus of the Create Effect and Play Effect actions. The Radius parameter is ignored. The Color parameter picks a Team Color if given a non-Team Color. For first-person effects, Position expects a player.</td>
			<td>2</td>
		</tr>
		<tr>
			<td><a href="https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/workshop+extensions+-+debuff+status+effects+reference+sheet">Debuff Status Effects</a></td>
			<td>Adds effects to the Type menus of the Create Effect and Play Effect actions. The Radius parameter is ignored. The Color parameter picks a Team Color if given a non-Team Color. For first-person effects, Position expects a player.<br></td>
			<td>2</td>
		</tr>
		<tr>
			<td><a href="https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/workshop+extensions+-+energy+explosion+effects+reference+sheet">Energy Explosion Effects</a></td>
			<td>Adds effects to the Type menu of the Play Effect action. The Radius parameter is ignored. The Color parameter picks a Team Color if given a non-Team Color.<br></td>
			<td>4</td>
		</tr>
		<tr>
			<td><a href="https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/workshop+extensions+-+explosion+sounds+reference+sheet">Explosion Sounds</a></td>
			<td>Adds sounds to the Type menu of the Play Effect action.</td>
			<td>2</td>
		</tr>
		<tr>
			<td><a href="https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/workshop+extensions+-+kinetic+explosion+effects+reference+sheet+">Kinetic Explosion Effects</a></td>
			<td>Adds effects to the Type menu of the Play Effect action. The Radius parameter is ignored. The Color parameter picks a Team Color if given a non-Team Color.</td>
			<td>4</td>
		</tr>
		<tr>
			<td>Play More <a href="https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/effects+reference+sheet">Effects</a></td>
			<td>Doubles the number of effects allowed to be played at a time.</td>
			<td>1</td>
		</tr>
		<tr>
			<td><a href="https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/projectile-effect">Projectiles</a></td>
			<td>Adds projectiles to the Projectile Type menu of the Create Projectile actions.</td>
			<td>4</td>
		</tr>
		<tr>
			<td>Spawn More <a href="https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/create+dummy+bot">Dummy Bots</a></td>
			<td>Increases the maximum number of allowed dummy bots by 12.</td>
			<td>2</td>
		</tr>
	</tbody>
</table>
````
